info.name: SecureVault - 02 - Authentication and Registration
info.description: Source-mapped manual API lab for the existing 3-mangal backend. All writes, email sends and credential reads require armed_request equal to their TC ID and consume that setting once. Mail-sending cases require verified Mailpit mode. See POSTMAN_TEST_GUIDE.md. No live test has been executed by importing this file.

request.description:
TC010 · Expected HTTP 202. Authentication: none.

Opaque acknowledgement does not prove insertion. Complete login and identity checks.

Execution: select this one request and set armed_request=TC010. 

JSON template (serialized safely by its pre-request script):
```json
{
  "username": "{{test_username}}",
  "email": "{{test_email}}",
  "password": "{{test_password}}"
}
```

exec: const spec = {"folder":1,"id":"TC010","name":"Register synthetic owner","method":"POST","path":"/api/registration/register","status":[202],"auth":"none","shape":"ack","body":{"username":"{{test_username}}","email":"{{test_email}}","password":"{{test_password}}"},"fixture":true,"note":"Opaque acknowledgement does not prove insertion. Complete login and identity checks.","requestName":"TC010 Register synthetic owner [MANUAL]"};
const text = value => typeof value === "string" ? value : String(value || "");
if (value === undefined || value === null || text(value) === "") stop();
if (typeof value === "string") return value.replace(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g, (_, key) => text(key === "future_expiry" ? pm.variables.get(key) : get(key)));
if (value && typeof value === "object") return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [key, expand(item)]));
pm.test("Opaque registration acknowledgement", () => { pm.expect(j.code === "REQUEST_RECEIVED" && typeof j.message === "string" && !j.id && !j.accessToken).to.equal(true); });
if (value && typeof value === "object") return Object.entries(value).every(([key,item]) => !(forbidden.has(key) && item != null && item !== "") && clean(item));
pm.test("Metadata/error response exposes no secret values", () => pm.expect(clean(j)).to.equal(true));

request.description:
TC016 · Expected HTTP 200. Authentication: user.

Verifies the token belongs to the expected svpm_ test account before any user-data mutation.

Execution: select this one request and set armed_request=TC016 (not required for this read).

exec: const spec = {"folder":1,"id":"TC016","name":"Verify user synthetic identity","method":"GET","path":"/api/account/me","status":[200],"auth":"user","shape":"identity","identityRole":"user","note":"Verifies the token belongs to the expected svpm_ test account before any user-data mutation.","requestName":"TC016 Verify user synthetic identity [READ]"};
const text = value => typeof value === "string" ? value : String(value || "");
if (value === undefined || value === null || text(value) === "") stop();
if (typeof value === "string") return value.replace(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g, (_, key) => text(key === "future_expiry" ? pm.variables.get(key) : get(key)));
if (value && typeof value === "object") return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [key, expand(item)]));
pm.test("Account identity and roles", () => { pm.expect(typeof j.id === "string" && typeof j.username === "string" && Array.isArray(j.roles)).to.equal(true); });
if (value && typeof value === "object") return Object.entries(value).every(([key,item]) => !(forbidden.has(key) && item != null && item !== "") && clean(item));

pm.test("Session belongs to the intended synthetic user", () => pm.expect(identityMatches).to.equal(true));
